svg.title: Forgetting run I: the outpost gates
svg.desc: Sketch set for the first forgetting run, in graphite: the forest path to the ranger outpost. Blank paper eats the world from the left; the ground near it is dense pencil, the path ahead a dashed outline, and the palisade gates at the right edge are still only half inked in. Three touchstone lanterns stand along the way.
